verdict.rationale: LightSprint gives every task on the board its own isolated full-stack sandbox, runs background cloud agents to clear bug backlogs, and supports exploring variations in parallel. Together these indicate many agent tasks can run concurrently, though concurrency is implied rather than stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent task limits or scale, throughput or orchestration controls for many simultaneous agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
